messages:
maria: Quick heads up — PR #3421 (opt-tooling) added a Node prefetch + batching snippet for short-sequence workloads but CI lint is failing and one example link points to the old console path. Can we triage before we merge?

alex: I skimmed it. failing lint is trailing comma in snippet and a missing import. happy to fix if nobody else is on it. :+1:

cheng: Also noticed the quant profile section recommends `q4_0` for short seqs. we should add a caveat about kv-cache warmup on repeated identical prefixes — it regresses perf in microbenchmarks. small text blurb should suffice.

sam: Agree on the kv-cache note. For the Node snippet, we should show `batch_size: 8` + `kv_prefetch: true` explicitly. Lots of users copy-paste without defaults.

devin: Pinged infra to re-run the doc CI after alex pushes. infra said lint + linkcheck then staging deploy.

alex: Pushed a tiny fix: removed trailing comma, added `import {redwood} from '@redwood/infer'` placeholder, updated link to https://console.redwood.ai/optimize/batching (was pointing to the old docs path).

maria: Thanks. cheng can you add the kv-cache caveat text? keep it 1-2 lines with a suggested mitigation — `increase batch_size` or `enable prefix caching` for repeated identical prompts.

cheng: Draft: "Note: when using aggressive quantization (q4_0/q4_k) with very short prompts, KV-cache warmup can inflate p50 until the cache fills. Mitigation: run a small warmup batch or bump batch_size to 4–8 to amortize overhead." ok?

sam: nit: use en-dash vs hyphen? nah fine. Also adding an inline example for Node:

```js
// Node SDK - short-seq batching + kv-prefetch example
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood/llama-70b-q4_k',
  prompt: 'Summarize this',
  batch_size: 8,
  kv_prefetch: true,
  max_tokens: 64
});
console.log(resp[0].text);
```

maria: perfect. I'll run the linkcheck locally then queue for merge. devin did infra confirm re-run?

devin: infra re-run complete, linkcheck passed, staging deploy looks clean. :rocket:

alex: CI green here as well. ready to merge.

maria: merging in 5. will tag for backport to v1.9 docs.

docs-bot: PR #3421 merged by maria — docs/staging deployed to https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize (build 7643).

maria: added a short release note to the changelog: "Improve Node SDK prefetch example and add KV-cache guidance for short sequences." closing thread. :tada:
